riskExamples.english:
Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.

=== Skill recommendations ===

; Countering Searing Flames
There are several techniques to effectively counter Searing Flames:
* Bring skills that interrupt or inflict Dazed.
* Use Frigid Armor to prevent being set on fire. 
* Signet of Humility will prevent Searing Flames from being cast; Diversion will disable it for an extended period.
* The boss will quickly kill itself while hexed with either Pain Inverter or Spoil Victor.

; Other skills

* Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm will reduce the elemental damage.
* Winter converts all elemental damage to cold damage, which deals more damage to Ruby Djinns.
* Extinguish and Breath of the Great Dwarf remove Burning from all party members.
* Frozen Soil will prevent the Roaring Ethers from using Resurrection Signet.
* The ethers are the only fleshy foes in Korshek's group, so it does not help much to bring skills that cause Bleeding, Disease, or Poison; similarly, skills that exploit corpses are ineffective for this battle.
* Consider going to open the Do Not Touch Treasure in Forum Highlands after killing Korshek the Immolated, which is near the boss' location.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
riskExamples.chinese:
Korshek 的團隊包括幾個 Roaring Ethers 和至少一個其他巨靈怪。還有多達三個衛星組，每個衛星組由更多的巨靈怪和 Roaring Ethers 組成。在困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈可以使用液態火焰進行非常猛烈的攻擊（超過 200 傷害），而 Korshek 則使用爆裂火焰，它可以對 60 裝甲等級角色造成超過 250 的傷害。這意味著，即使沒有死刑，整個隊伍也可以在兩到三擊中被消滅，因為這些都是範圍性攻擊。考慮從提哈克果園外的梅蘭朵守望者那裡獲得遮蔽樹枝的祝福，以減少 Korshek 和紅寶石巨靈造成的傷害。

=== 技能建議 ===

;對抗爆裂火焰
有多種技術可以有效對抗爆裂火焰：
* 帶來打斷或造成暈眩的技能。
* 使用冰凍護甲防止起火。 
* 謙卑紋章將阻止爆裂火焰被施放； 牽制將長時間停用它。
* 當使用苦痛變頻器或勝者的掠奪施咒時，Boss 會快速自殺。

;其他技能

* 元素結界或守護結界將減少元素傷害。
* 寒冬將所有元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害，這對紅寶石魔靈造成更多傷害。
* 熄滅和偉大矮人的呼吸消除了所有隊伍成員的燃燒。
* 凍土將阻止咆哮以太使用復活紋章。
* 以太是Korshek團隊中唯一的肉質敵人，因此帶來導致流血、疾病或中毒的技能並沒有多大幫助；同樣的，利用屍體的技能對於這場戰鬥也是無效的。
* 殺死靠近boss位置的宰殺者科薛克後，考慮開啟高地廣場中的請勿觸控寶藏。
完成記錄屬於接受任務的輪替。它不會改變永久技能或征服進步。

riskExamples.english:
Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor. Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak. 

===Skill recommendations===
* You will not encounter any physical attackers, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have Stun on Critical Hit.
* Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not fleshy creatures, so skills that exploit corpses and inflict bleeding, disease, or poison are ineffective against them.
* You will only encounter spellcaster mobs, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, and Winnowing).
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against blunt damage, so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
riskExamples.chinese:
向北穿過譚納凱神殿可探索區域從辛庫走廊 。做好應對周圍聖殿守護者造成的區域火焰傷害的準備。如果你沿著右邊地圖上的路徑走，你只會在去的路上遇到神廟守護者。 通靈者魁嵩 。 

=== 技能推薦===
* 你不會遇到任何物理攻擊者，因此格擋、失手、致盲的技能在這裡效果較差；然而，聖殿守護者在暴擊時會暈眩。
* 通靈者魁嵩神殿守護者不是肉質生物，因此利用屍體並造成流血、疾病或中毒的技能對他們無效。
*你只會遇到施法者小怪，所以考慮帶上反施法者技能和/或各種遊俠可以使你的隊伍受益但不能使神殿守護者受益的自然儀式（例如順風 , 怒火 , 和吹拂之風 ）。
* 神殿守護者對寒冷傷害的護甲等級較低，所以考慮帶上寒冬或造成寒冷傷害的技能。考慮帶水系魔法誘捕並造成寒冷傷害的十六進製法術（即強力凍結 , 冰之尖刺 , 心靈凍結 , 和冰風暴 ），這會減慢他們的移動速度，並有助於防止他們到達你的中線/後線並造成聖殿守護者的空白區域效果傷害雙龍和通靈者魁嵩的先人的盛怒 。
* 聖殿守衛針對鈍器傷害的護甲等級較低，因此請考慮使用造成鈍器傷害的武器。

完成記錄屬於接受任務的輪替。它不會改變永久技能或征服進步。

riskExamples.english:
Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
**The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
riskExamples.chinese:
一旦玩家進入重生點位置的雷達範圍，哈恩或瑪克辛就會重生並開始在島嶼周圍巡邏。 Boss 會在其巡邏路徑上逆時針行走，因此最好順時針行走其巡邏路徑，因為 Boss 在生成時會向您移動，並且您無需在眾多小怪中追逐 Boss。如果你順時針穿過它的巡邏路徑，就會有血肉傀儡和瑪戈九頭蛇的小怪在外面一圈巡邏。 殘火營地 。您的聚會可以住在附近復活祭壇並拉動每個小怪。

=== 技能推薦===
*如果你順時針穿過它的巡邏路徑：
**你只會遇到施法者小怪（暗焰乾燥者、龍、肉傀儡、瑪戈九頭蛇和幻影），所以考慮帶上反施法者技能和/或各種遊俠可以使你的隊伍受益但不能使敵方施法者受益的自然儀式（例如順風 , 怒火 , 毒性自從暗焰乾燥機使用以來凍傷 , 和吹拂之風 ）。
**唯一的物理攻擊者將是由血肉傀儡通過操縱骸骨爪牙 ，因此格擋、造成失誤或造成失明狀態的技能在這裡效果較差。
*此任務於四月首次提供 25 , 2009 。
*如果你順時針穿過boss的巡邏路徑，你可以藉此機會獲得火山岩 。
*哈恩或瑪克辛有可能在其路徑北部的海灘上生成
完成記錄屬於接受任務的輪替。它不會改變永久技能或征服進步。

riskExamples.english:
If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs, Minotaurs, Rockshot Devourers, and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.

Avoid using condition-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use Plague Touch and then Virulence. Marrow Scarabs use Well of the Profane, so either interrupt its activation, avoid bringing enchantments with long recharge times, and/or move away from corpses before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.

Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use Distracting Shot, so skills that block, inflict the blind condition, cause misses, or prevent interruption can be helpful. They also use numerous traps, so it may be a good idea to have one party member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.

Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
* Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Family Soul quest, since it also requires you to kill her.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
riskExamples.chinese:
如果您按照右側地圖中的路徑前進，則在前往柯柏海特食隨者的途中只會遇到骨髓聖甲蟲、牛頭怪、Rockshot 蠍和聖甲蟲築巢者。去除妖術的技能是不必要的，因為上述敵人不會施放妖術。

避免對骨髓聖甲蟲使用造成條件的技能，因為它們會使用疫病之觸，然後使用惡毒。骨髓聖甲蟲使用褻瀆之池，因此要麼中斷其啟用，避免帶來較長充電時間的加持，和/或在屍體被利用以建立褻瀆之池之前遠離屍體。

Rockshot 蠍和 Scarab Nest Builders 使用震暈之箭，因此阻擋、造成盲態、導致錯誤或防止中斷的技能可能會有所幫助。他們也使用許多陷阱，因此最好讓一名隊伍成員走在隊伍前面來觸發陷阱並防止整個隊伍受到傷害。

有時，柯柏海特食隨者一開始是隱藏的，直到隊伍成員接近她的重生點時才會彈出。如果受到平弓或長弓範圍的攻擊，柯柏海特食隨者周圍的聖甲蟲築巢者將不會移動，因此您可以在您的隊伍與柯柏海特食隨者交戰之前透過治療和保護聖甲蟲築巢者來耗盡柯柏海特食隨者的能量。當你靠近柯柏海特食隨者時，會彈出幾隻骨髓聖甲蟲。如果柯柏海特食隨者對自己施放守護印記，則套用條件或十六進位將導致她使用純淨的冥想並移除守護印記。
*考慮與家庭靈魂任務同時完成這個任務，因為它也需要你殺死她。
完成記錄屬於接受任務的輪替。它不會改變永久技能或征服進步。

riskExamples.english: Once inside the dungeon, it is very helpful to take your time with the skeletons and zombies. Two groups at once will be very dangerous to the party. Holy damage is effective, while physical attackers will have trouble due to the many blinding skills. One method is to bring seven heroes with "Charge!"/"Incoming!" and/or "Fall Back!" and stagger their uses in order to run right past the enemies. If the party racks up too much Death Penalty, the zombie groups can be impossible to kill. It's sometimes possible to get past them by creative flagging of henchmen/heroes. Flag your healers off to the sides and a strong tank in front of the first group. Flag the rest of your henchmen on the second group, off to the side so they don't get tangled up in the first group. An alternate way is to take the north side when you reach the breach halfway through the map, because there are only two groups up there and no healers (however there are more warriors to do heavy damage). After half a dozen tries you should be able to pass them and activate the next Resurrection Shrine. Once you activate the second shrine, you can follow the path on the quest map to avoid the remaining mobs all together.
riskExamples.chinese: 一旦進入地牢，花點時間與骷髏和殭屍相處是非常有幫助的。兩個團體同時出現對隊伍來說將是非常危險的。 神聖傷害是有效的，而實體攻擊者會因為許多致盲技能而遇到麻煩。一種方法是帶七個英雄一起「衝鋒！」/「來襲！」和/或「撤退！」並錯開它們的使用，以便從敵人身邊跑過。如果隊伍被判過多的死刑，那麼殭屍群就不可能被殺。有時可以透過創造性地標記追隨者/英雄來繞過它們。將你的治療師標記到兩側，並在第一組前面放置一個強大的坦克。將你的其他追隨者標記為第二組，放在一邊，這樣他們就不會與第一組糾纏在一起。另一種方法是當你到達地圖中途的缺口時佔領北側，因為那裡只有兩個小組並且沒有治療者（但有更多的戰士可以造成嚴重傷害）。經過六次嘗試後，您應該能夠通過它們並啟動下一個復活祭壇。一旦你啟動了第二個神殿，你就可以沿著任務地圖上的路徑前進，以避免剩下的小怪。

riskExamples.english: At start, you need to avoid Sokka; turn left, staying in the grass. Cross the tree-trunk bridge by the left kiln and clear the Destroyers occupying the hill including the group waiting to go down to the Eastern kiln. Once you have cleared the green area, you can leave your party just below the last tree on the green side of the hilltop at the edge of the burnt-out spawning grounds. One player must return to Sokka to trigger the kilns, then return to the party to confront the Destroyer spawns that occur within the spawning grounds. Finally, two Bringers of Destruction will appear with assorted other Destroyers. The party should move away and lose aggro at this time; the Destroyers will stay near their spawn point and not chase the party. Defeating the Bringers of Destruction at this point can trigger bugs that make the mission impossible to complete. You can then go talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
riskExamples.chinese: 一開始，你需要避開Sokka；左轉，留在草地上。穿過左側窯爐旁的樹幹橋，清除佔據山頭的破壞者，包括等待下東窯爐的隊伍。一旦你清理了綠色區域，你就可以把你的隊伍留在燒毀的產卵場邊緣山頂綠色一側的最後一棵樹下方。一名玩家必須返回索卡觸發窯爐，然後返回隊伍以對抗在產卵場內出現的毀滅者產卵。最後，兩位毀滅帶來者將與其他各種驅逐艦一起出現。此時隊伍應該離開並失去仇恨；驅逐艦將停留在其重生點附近，不會追趕隊伍。此時擊敗毀滅的使者可能會觸發錯誤，使任務無法完成。然後你可以去與索卡交談，這樣他就會跟著你並向你提供阿蘇蘭信標，它會產生一對 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0。這些傀儡會跟著你，所以你可以立即開始移動。與傀儡交談以在等待和跟隨模式之間切換；放下一個信標來替換你的傀儡。

riskExamples.english: After clearing the room, head to the gate. Once you kill the Tremor in front of it, Destroyers will start spawning from the gate, one at a time. You can try to kill the Asura Gate while holding off the Destroyers, or the slower but much easier method is to ignore the gate and kill each Destroyer as it spawns. You should have plenty of time to kill one before the next shows up. After about the 10th Destroyer, they'll stop spawning and you can kill the Asura Gate at your leisure. Or you can completely ignore the mobs that spawn and just attack the gate, it goes down pretty fast and you should get it without dying. Alternatively, if you are having trouble with the Destroyers that spawn in the gate, you can try to pull them right. You can run back to the entrance of the room and they should stay there. Then simply hug the wall and go to the gate and destroy it.
riskExamples.chinese: 清理完房間後，前往大門。一旦你殺死了前面的震顫，驅逐艦就會開始從大門中生成，一次一個。你可以嘗試在阻止驅逐艦的同時殺死阿蘇拉門，或者更慢但更簡單的方法是忽略門並在每個驅逐艦生成時殺死它。在下一個出現之前，你應該有足夠的時間殺死一個。在大約第 10 驅逐艦之後，它們將停止生成，您可以在閒暇時殺死阿蘇拉門。或者你可以完全忽略生成的小怪，只攻擊大門，它下降得很快，你應該在不死的情況下得到它。或者，如果您在處理大門中生成的毀滅者時遇到麻煩，您可以嘗試將它們拉到正確的位置。你可以跑回房間入口，他們應該留在那裡。然後簡單地抱住牆壁，走到大門處並摧毀它。

riskExamples.english: On the second level, if you do not take Raven blessing, sometimes you will encounter the default mobs instead of Destroyers. On the third level, the Destroyers sometimes do not spawn until you reach the final area that has the Asura Gate. On the third level, if the first Destroyer Tremor isn't attacked by the party the 3 Destroyers that are supposed to protect the second Tremor will almost always remain inactive at their spawn point a bit behind it until they are attacked. If the rest of your party wipes and Ogden and/or Vekk are in the party, they will resurrect where they died, as soon as the final dialogue begins (as you enter the last room).
riskExamples.chinese: 在第二層，如果你不接受烏鴉祝福，有時你會遇到預設的小怪而不是毀滅者。在第三層，驅逐艦有時不會生成，直到您到達具有阿蘇拉門的最終區域。在第三層，如果第一個驅逐艦震顫沒有受到隊伍的攻擊，那麼應該保護第二個震顫的 3 驅逐艦幾乎總是在其後面一點的產卵點保持不活動狀態，直到它們受到攻擊。如果你的隊伍中的其他人抹掉了，並且奧格登和/或維克在隊伍中，那麼一旦最後的對話開始（當你進入最後一個房間時），他們就會在死亡的地方復活。

riskExamples.english: Plow your way through some basic cave critters to make your way to Renk and Sokka then fend off the nearby destroyers. Oola will alert the party of a missing Vanguard group nearby. You'll find Captain Langmar a short way away accompanied by Chance Redding and Jenn Valefield. Continuing west, you'll see a number of Vanguard groups engaged with destroyers. You can try to save them, but the destroyers will likely kill them. South, you'll see a large battle between the Vanguard and destroyers. Again, the odds are stacked in favor of the destroyers, so it's often best to simply rush to the zone on the other side of the room while the Vanguard have the Destroyers occupied.
riskExamples.chinese: 穿過一些基本的洞穴生物，到達倫克和索卡，然後擊退附近的驅逐艦。烏拉將向隊伍發出附近失蹤先鋒隊的警報。您會發現隊長連瑪就在不遠處，由 Chance Redding 和 Jenn Valefield 陪同。繼續向西，你會看到許多先鋒隊與驅逐艦交戰。你可以嘗試拯救他們，但毀滅者很可能會殺死他們。在南方，你會看到先鋒隊和驅逐艦之間的一場大規模戰鬥。同樣，驅逐艦的勝算很大，因此通常最好在先鋒隊佔領驅逐艦時衝到房間另一側的區域。

riskExamples.english: Level 2: Here, you'll have to reactivate the golems. A short way outside, you'll see dryders and destroyers. These groups will battle if they come within aggro range of each other. Try to run by the second group of dryders on your way to the Norn. Once at the Norn, Destroyers will start coming in from multiple fronts. Taking them all on at the same time may be tricky, but if you position yourself away from the center (where the quest marker is), you can avoid aggro with half the assault group until you're ready for them. Another tactic is to let the golems die along the bridge, blocking the path, and thus protecting you from the Destroyers' deadly warriors and dervishes while you attack with arrows and spells. Once the assault is over, follow Olaf Olafson to where he will open a door. Follow this path, fight a few more Destroyers, and enter the portal by the Stone Dwarves into the Central Transfer Chamber. Don't spend too much time with Dwarves, or you will be caught up with large swarm of Destroyers which have followed your trails.
riskExamples.chinese: 2 關卡：在這裡，您必須重新啟動傀儡。外面不遠的地方，您會看到乾燥機和驅逐艦。如果這些團體進入彼此的仇恨範圍內，就會發生戰鬥。嘗試在前往諾恩的途中經過第二組乾燥機。一旦到達諾恩，驅逐艦將開始從多條前線進攻。同時對付他們可能會很棘手，但如果你將自己放置在遠離中心（任務標記所在的地方）的位置，你可以避免與一半的突擊隊發生仇恨，直到你準備好對付他們。另一個策略是讓傀儡沿著橋死去，擋住道路，從而在你用箭和法術攻擊時保護你免受毀滅者致命的戰士和托缽僧的傷害。攻擊結束後，跟著尤拉夫尤拉夫森到他會開門的地方。沿著這條路，與更多的毀滅者戰鬥，然後通過石矮人進入中央傳送室的傳送門。不要在矮人身上花太多時間，否則你會被一大群追隨你蹤跡的毀滅者追上。

riskExamples.english: Note that this method can be used, with slight modification, to easily gain mission and bonus. Have two people run crystals, the second waiting by the crystal spawn point to pick it up the moment the other has attuned a pedestal. It is important that these two do not attune the last pedestal until the bonus is gained. A third person, or the rest of the party, kills the Demagogue. This can easily be done by following the south wall, you should not need to kill any White Mantle other than him if you take this path. Now the most important part: do not aggro the White Mantle runners. Two non-buffed runners can easily keep the portals attuned without hindering the White Mantle. If a third human player is not present, then this method can be done using only two. The Demagogue slayer (with the bulk of the team) retraces steps and becomes the second runner after the bonus has been gained.
riskExamples.chinese: 請注意，此方法只需稍加修改即可輕鬆獲得任務和獎勵。讓兩個人跑水晶，第二個在水晶產卵點等待，當另一個人調整了底座時撿起它。重要的是，在獲得獎金之前，這兩個人不要調整最後一個基座。第三人或隊伍的其他成員殺死了煽動者。這可以透過沿著南牆輕鬆完成，如果你走這條路，你不需要殺死除他之外的任何白斗篷。現在最重要的部分是：不要激怒白斗篷跑者。兩位未拋光的跑者可以輕鬆地保持門戶協調，而不會妨礙白斗篷。如果第三個人玩家不存在，則可以僅使用兩個人來完成此方法。 煽動者殺手（與團隊的大部分成員）在獲得獎金後折返並成為第二名跑者。

riskExamples.english: The Morale Boost granted upon killing a Sand Giant also affects animal companions. In the last round, Lyssha Suss's (Custodian Phebus's) team may be tagged as Defeated without even having been engaged. If this happens, the player can ignore this group and finish the mission by just killing the other two teams. Sometimes, a chest will spawn at the entrance to Issah Sshay's chamber which the Ghostly Hero may become stuck on. If this happens the team must resign and begin the mission again. If you pull enemies to the Ghostly Hero before he opens the first gate, he may spend too long fighting them and never open the gate.
riskExamples.chinese: 殺死沙巨人後獲得計程車氣提升也會影響動物夥伴。在最後一輪中，萊莎·蘇斯（Lyssha Suss）（守護者菲比斯）的隊伍甚至可能在沒有交戰的情況下就被標記為「擊敗」。如果發生這種情況，玩家可以忽略這支隊伍，只需殺死另外兩支隊伍即可完成任務。有時，依沙席房間的入口處會產生一個箱子，英雄之魂可能會卡在上面。如果發生這種情況，團隊必須辭職並重新開始任務。如果你在敵人開啟第一道門之前將敵人拉到英雄之魂，他可能會花太長時間與他們戰鬥而永遠不會開啟門。

riskExamples.english: This room has no environmental effect. Instead, you'll fight swarms of Crystal Spiders, with Forgotten Illusionists backing them up. The spiders spam Shatter Enchantment and Hex Breaker, so be wary of hex and enchantment usage. Some of the Illusionists hide behind solid crystal walls that do not hinder their indirect spells, but which shield them from melee and projectile assault. As such, a few strong indirect spells of your own are useful here, but be sure to watch out for their Chaos Storm. It's worth taking the time to destroy them with spells before engaging new groups of spiders, because together these opponents can present a tough battle, especially in hard mode. The back of the room has a twisted path leading to the Facet of Chaos. Pairs of Illusionists will cast across the low walls of the path, but projectile attacks can reach them.
riskExamples.chinese: 該房間對環境沒有影響。相反，您將與成群的水晶蜘蛛作戰，並有被遺忘者幻術師作為後盾。蜘蛛會傳送加持粉碎和破咒頌歌垃圾郵件，因此請警惕十六進位和加持的使用。有些幻術師隱藏在堅固的水晶牆後面，這不會妨礙他們的間接法術，但可以保護他們免受近戰和投射物攻擊。因此，你自己的一些強大的間接咒語在這裡很有用，但一定要注意它們的混沌風暴。在與新的蜘蛛群交戰之前，值得花時間用法術消滅它們，因為這些對手在一起可以帶來一場艱苦的戰鬥，尤其是在困難模式下。房間後面有一條蜿蜒的小路通往渾沌之分身。成對的幻術師會穿過道路的矮牆施法，但投射物攻擊可以到達他們。

riskExamples.english: A little while after the first Stone Summit group the mob of Mursaat passes on the frozen lake, there is a Shiverpeak Chest which the Mursaat sometimes will get stuck on and stop moving. If this happens, you will have to retry the mission or attempt to have an infused player pull them away from it. The Mursaat stops after the stone bridge. Sometimes Evennia will not follow you; sometimes she may follow Saidra and gets killed by Mursaat; you must restart the mission if this happens. Sometimes Rornak Stonesledge will not be at his location, making it impossible to claim the bonus without restarting the mission. Occasionally, a stray barrage from the siege weapons will land near the spawn of Virag Bladestone, harming the party. The Mursaat are not hostile to Darda Goldenchief's group. Sometimes, a Shiverpeak Chest will spawn in an unreachable location near the ice boat siege engines.
riskExamples.chinese: 在第一個石峰矮人組後不久，馬賽特的暴徒經過結冰的湖面，有一個 Shiverpeak 寶箱，馬賽特有時會被卡住並停止移動。如果發生這種情況，你將不得不重試任務或嘗試讓已註入的玩家將他們拉離任務。 馬賽特在石橋後停了下來。有時伊凡妮雅不會跟隨您；有時她可能會跟隨 Saidra 並被馬賽特殺死；如果發生這種情況，您必須重新啟動任務。有時洛奈科斯通萊基不會在他的位置，因此無法在不重新啟動任務的情況下領取獎金。有時，攻城武器的雜散彈幕會落在刃巖畢拉克的產卵點附近，對隊伍造成傷害。 馬賽特對金首達勒塔的組織並無敵意。有時，席瓦峰寶箱會在冰船攻城引擎附近無法到達的位置產生。

riskExamples.english: Enchantment Spell. For 22…40 seconds, target ally has +24 armor, +60 maximum Health, and an additional +24 armor against Destroyers.
riskExamples.chinese: 加持魔法。在 22…40 秒內，目標盟友擁有 +24 護甲、+60 最大體力，以及針對驅逐艦的額外 +24 護甲。

riskExamples.english: Shout. (30 seconds.) Resurrect all dead party members in earshot with full Health and Energy. Affected party members deal 25…33% more damage. Affected party members die when it ends, but do not receive a death penalty.
riskExamples.chinese: 戰嚎。 （30 秒。） 復活所有死去的隊員都在聽得見的範圍內，並具有完整的體力和能量。受影響的隊伍成員會造成 25…33% 更多傷害。受影響的黨員在結束時死亡，但不會被判死刑。

riskExamples.english: Spell. Projectile: deals 40…50 damage to target and adjacent foes. Deals 45…70 more damage and inflicts Cracked Armor condition (14…20 seconds) to Destroyers.
riskExamples.chinese: 咒文魔法。投射物：對目標和鄰近敵人造成 40…50 傷害。對驅逐艦造成 45…70 更多傷害並造成防禦破裂狀態（14…20 秒）。

riskExamples.english: Spell. Deals 5…33…40 lightning damage. Deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to two nearby foes if you are Overcast. 25% armor penetration.
riskExamples.chinese: 咒文魔法。造成 5…33…40 閃電傷害。如果您處於陰天狀態，會對附近的兩個敵人造成 15…71…85 閃電傷害。 25% 裝甲穿透力。

riskExamples.english: Hex Spell. (9…12 seconds.) You cannot miss target foe. If you kill this foe, you lose 5% Death Penalty.
riskExamples.chinese: 降咒魔法。 （9…12秒。）你不能錯過目標敵人。如果你殺死了這個敵人，你就會失去 5% 死刑。

riskExamples.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. (3…9…10 seconds.) Gives 50% block chance while attacking. End Effect: Causes Weakness 3…13…15 seconds to adjacent foes.
riskExamples.chinese: 快閃記憶體加持魔法。 （3…9…10 秒。）攻擊時給予 50% 格擋機會。最終效果：對相鄰敵人造成虛弱 3…13…15 秒。

riskExamples.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5…13…15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3…7…8 seconds) on nearby foes.
riskExamples.chinese: 快閃記憶體加持魔法。 （30 秒。）初始效果：對附近的敵人造成流血狀態（5…13…15 秒）。最終效果：對附近的敵人造成殘癈狀態（3…7…8 秒）。

riskExamples.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Initial effect: inflicts Bleeding condition (5…13…15 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition (3…7…8 seconds) on nearby foes.
riskExamples.chinese: 快閃記憶體加持魔法。 （30 秒。）初始效果：對附近的敵人造成流血狀態（5…13…15 秒）。最終效果：對附近的敵人造成殘癈狀態（3…7…8 秒）。

riskExamples.english: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) You deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Heal allies in earshot for 5…41…50 Health when you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
riskExamples.chinese: 精英表格。 （10…74…90 秒。）你造成神聖傷害。每當您使用神喚使攻擊技能時，就會失去 1 十六進位。當您失去神喚使加持時，為 5…41…50 體力治療聽力範圍內的盟友。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

riskExamples.english: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) Deal holy damage. You lose 1 hex whenever you use a Dervish attack skill. Heal yourself for 5…41…50 Health whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
riskExamples.chinese: 精英表格。 （10…74…90 秒。）造成神聖傷害。每當您使用神喚使攻擊技能時，您都會失去 1 十六進位。每當您失去神喚使加持時，請為 5…41…50 體力治療自己。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

riskExamples.english: Flash Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) Initial Effect: Inflicts burning (1…3…3 seconds) on nearby foes. End effect: gain 1…2…2 strikes of adrenaline if any foes are within earshot.
riskExamples.chinese: 快閃記憶體加持魔法。 （20 秒。）初始效果：對附近的敵人造成燃燒（1…3…3 秒）。最終效果：如果任何敵人在聽力範圍內，則會獲得 1…2…2 腎上腺素攻擊。

riskExamples.english: Elite Spell. Heals for 10…98…120. Removes one condition and one hex.
riskExamples.chinese: 精英咒文魔法。 10…98…120 的治療。刪除一個病症和一個十六進位。
